__comment: LOCAL smoke-test inputs, for miniwdl/Cromwell on your own machine. For a Terra run, use gs:// paths instead — miniwdl cannot read them, and Cromwell on Terra cannot read local paths.
__comment_assemblies: These FASTAs are not committed (sequence files are gitignored, and they are large). Fetch them before running: B. burgdorferi B31 (GCF_000008685.2) and E. coli K-12 MG1655 (GCF_000005845.2) from NCBI.
__comment_busco: 'auto' places each assembly in the prokaryote tree independently. Set e.g. 'spirochaetales_odb10' to force one dataset across all samples.
__comment_checkm2: Local path to the CheckM2 DIAMOND database (~2.9 GB). This is the reference database, NOT the DIAMOND aligner binary — the aligner already ships inside staphb/checkm2:1.1.0.
